Title: March 26, 2026 City of Boulder City Council Study Session

Topic1.Title: Boulder Valley School District Enrollment Update
Topic1.Summary: BVSD leaders presented on sustained enrollment decline, with about 525 students lost this year and a projected further drop of about 1,700 students, driven by falling birth rates, an aging population, and housing costs. Elementary schools face the greatest impact, with many schools falling below two classes per grade level and losing programming. The district outlined a six-month community engagement process, with decisions on school adjustments planned for fall 2026. Council members asked about long-term planning horizons, the city's role in surplus facilities, and cost implications.

Topic2.Title: Review of Draft Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan with Planning Board
Topic2.Summary: Staff presented the draft update, which reduces policies from 210 to 102, restructures land use into four classes and twelve designations, and adds an implementation chapter and glossary. The draft expands housing opportunities by about 35% and modestly increases job capacity while aiming for more efficient resource use. Council and Planning Board members asked clarifying questions and largely supported the plan's direction, while raising concerns about neighborhood character language, transportation and parking, wildfire mitigation, water and climate planning, and tribal acknowledgment. Members discussed possible expansion of neighborhood two designations along transit corridors, with no consensus reached.
